submission_readiness.interpretation: 现有证据足以组织一篇不夸大口径的 DATE 稿件，但尚未形成可冻结提交的共同系统表。

acceptance_readiness.interpretation: 局部功能和物理证据强，系统分母、宏、能量和多序列证据弱。

best_paper_readiness.interpretation: 尚无同资源、宏计费、多序列的端到端主结果；增加模块数量不能弥补。

data_quality_findings.finding: 旧 620302905 cycle/frame 漏掉四个 ConvTranspose2d，只能称 included-scope envelope。
data_quality_findings.impact: 所有以旧分母为 full-network 的 Amdahl 和系统倍率在 decoder exact S10 加回前均不可准入。

data_quality_findings.finding: C2 4.764209x 是 K8 对低带宽 K1 的 FC2 局部前端比；M472 2.459487x 是官方 Prosperity product-vs-bit 外部重放；C3 约 2x 是分析性局部值；A1 1.1865x 只覆盖 attention row core。
data_quality_findings.impact: 这些数不能相乘、不能共用 system speedup 列，也不能冒充同资源整网加速。

data_quality_findings.finding: headline 候选缺少共同目标 SRAM macro、DRAM address-timed energy 和 full-frame energy；C1 与 A1 的功耗均是 pre-macro 局部证据。
data_quality_findings.impact: 无法形成 Prosperity/Phi 风格的面积、功率、能量、带宽同表。

data_quality_findings.finding: 当前 S10 是同一 Zurich sequence 的十个窗口，不是十条 sequence。
data_quality_findings.impact: 无法证明低、中、高事件密度和最坏序列下性能稳定。

data_quality_findings.finding: M514 r2 静态评审覆盖的 RTL/TB SHA 为 7543a25c/10392f18；当前磁盘 SHA 已变为 90c44fc9/6c283bf9。当前代码看似包含上界修复和 size-32 向量，但没有 r3 独立封存或 exact-SHA VCS。
data_quality_findings.impact: M514 当前身份不可写成 verified RTL。

data_quality_findings.finding: M496 r3 one-shot 在截点已消费且 K1 DC mapping 正在进行，canonical result 不存在。
data_quality_findings.impact: 任何 K1/K8/K1x8 matched PPA 比例在最终三点回执和盲审前均不可引用。

if_pass: Freeze C2 as the primary hardware headline together with C1.
Do not develop new RTL; run three-point Formality, matched SAIF/PTPX, and common SRAM macro charging.
Write the main claim as equal-peak throughput retention with at most half the K1x8 area/state and at most 0.70x energy/token, not as 4.764x equal-resource speedup.
Keep C3 only if its fair fixed/macro energy gate closes; otherwise use two hardware contributions.
if_complete_but_design_gate_fails: Kill C2 as a physical headline and preserve M216 as a standalone frontend ablation.
Do not redesign K8/K1x8 in this paper sprint.
Use C1 as the sole hard physical anchor; C3 must close same-boundary baseline and state energy to become the second hardware contribution.
A1 and M514 remain supporting completeness; expected DATE acceptance falls to roughly 20-30% unless the system energy table is strong.
if_resource_failure_only: Classify as no-result, not a design failure.
Allow only one newly reviewed isolated-host replay with identical RTL/TCL/SDC/libraries/effort/order; no partial citation.
If the schedule cannot support that replay, submit without C2 matched-PPA headline rather than weakening resource gates.

red_lines: Do not multiply C1/C2/C3/A1/M472 local ratios.
Do not place M472 2.459487x in an ours-speedup column.
Do not call M514 an EPD speedup engine.
Do not sum standalone module areas into chip area.
Do not infer mJ/frame from pJ/measured-cycle or nJ/head-row without full invocation and memory accounting.
Do not call ten Zurich windows ten sequences.
Do not mix lossless and lossy checkpoints or metrics in one column.
